opening.argument: The video explains a retail payment service: customers can use ADA for groceries at 137 SPAR stores across Switzerland. It walks through selecting ADA and seeing the amount due, while the accompanying material shows how the payment flow works and how it can be integrated into point-of-sale systems. Those are explanations of an ordinary purchase, not requests for credentials, investment funds, or personal data. Separate referral and channel-support links are mentioned, but the available video evidence does not connect them to a deceptive offer or to the grocery-payment discussion. The observable focus remains how a customer pays a merchant.
